items.title: Build with OpenAI Codex
items.location: Online
items.summary: October's build is OpenAI's Codex, one of the leading AI coding agents. If you've heard people talk about AI writing code for them and wondered what that actually looks like in practice, this is your chance to try it yourself. No coding experience or background needed, just you and your laptop. We'll give you a sample project and 90 minutes of hands-on time to see how Codex works along with guidance in prompting and getting the result you want without having to burn loads of tokens. items.title: Working with AI to Build Dashboards People Understand | Marjolein Opsteegh
items.location: Online
items.summary: AI can help us build dashboards faster than ever before. But faster does not automatically mean better. In this session, Marjolein Opsteegh shares practical examples of how she works together with AI while designing Power BI dashboards. You'll see where AI can save time, generate ideas, and challenge your thinking, but also where human judgment remains essential. The focus is not on writing DAX or creating visuals more quickly. It is about building dashboards that people can actually understand, interpret, and use to make decisions. Through real-world examples, you'll learn how AI can help improve report structure, navigation, storytelling, accessibility, and overall user experience. Whether…

items.summary: ## Welcome to the Seventh BDEN Meetup! AI is moving fast, and developers are right in the middle of it.
